description: Search a workbook's text by pattern: cell contents, and the text that is in no cell — comments, shapes, charts and defined names. Returns grid-anchored matches, each tagged with the layer it matched. Selection by attribute (fills, formats, features) is the regions read, not grep.

context.description: Annotate and group matches by the block they sit in: contentful (the uniform data region; bare -C means this) or table (enclosing table only). Not a line count — a grid has no ±N lines.

fields.description: Layers to search: display (number format applied), value (the stored scalar, what getValue() returns — 0.4 behind 40%, dates as serials; duplicate of display suppressed per cell), formula, hyperlink, numberFormat (the format code, e.g. "0.00%"), comment (comments, notes and replies), shape (text on a shape, alt text), chart (title, axis titles, literal series names, alt text), name (defined names and tables: the name, what it refers to, its comment). (default: ["display","formula","comment","shape","chart","name"])

fixedStrings.description: Treat the pattern as a literal string, not a regular expression. (default: false)

hidden.description: Search hidden rows, columns and sheets, which are excluded by default. Naming a hidden sheet in scope always searches it. (default: false)

invert.description: Report cells and objects where no requested field matched. Only those with text in a requested field are considered — blanks are not findings. (default: false)

maxCount.description: Stop after this many matching cells and objects (0 = unlimited). Truncation is always reported, and only when a further match actually exists. (default: 200)

output.description: What to return: content (address, layer and text), addresses (one per matched cell), count (per sheet), or sheets (names with a match). (default: "content")

pattern.description: The regular expression to search for (literal with fixedStrings).

scope.description: Where to search: a sheet name (globs allowed: "Q*"), a sheet-qualified range (Sheet1!A1:D9), or a bare range applied to every sheet. Defaults to every used range.

session_id.description: Target session id, from `info` or `list_sessions`. Required.

word.description: Require the match to fall on word boundaries (text edges count as edges). (default: false)

name: grep
